features.name: log_population_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed population P1 normalized by training mean and std to create a smooth continuous score suitable for linear margins
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed population distribution into approximately normal range, improving linear SVM margin separation

features.name: housing_occupancy_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of housing occupancy indicators H10p1 and H13p1 reflecting overall housing utilization pattern
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines complementary housing metrics into a single smooth score for linear projection

features.name: person_ratio_balance
features.description: Ratio of P5p1 to P16p2 capturing relative balance between two person-proportion features, centered around expected equilibrium
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio captures relative proportional relationships that may be linearly separable in SVM feature space

features.name: housing_vacancy_score
features.description: Combined vacancy and alternative housing indicator from H2p2 and H8p2, representing degree of non-standard housing
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse housing indicators into a denser signal for linear decision boundary

features.name: demographic_spread_index
features.description: Measures spread across demographic proportion features P11p4, P14p9, and P27p4 as a sum of deviations from their training means
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures joint demographic deviation pattern useful for linear margin in SVM

features.name: housing_age_mobility_ratio
features.description: Ratio of H18pA to H40p4 capturing relationship between housing age indicator and housing turnover, with smoothing
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio of housing characteristics provides a continuous severity measure for linear SVM

features.name: person_housing_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between person proportion P15p1 and housing occupancy H10p1 capturing joint high-occupancy signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Multiplicative interaction approximates a nonlinear relationship in a single linear feature for SVM

features.name: minority_proportion_composite
features.description: Weighted sum of smaller proportion features P6p2, P15p3, and P18p2 representing combined minority-proportion signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse low-frequency proportion features into a denser composite for linear separability

features.name: housing_stability_score
features.description: Composite stability score combining H10p1 dominance with inverse of vacancy indicators H2p2 and H8p2
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth signed score of housing stability useful as a linear projection for SVM margin

features.name: population_density_deviation
features.description: Signed deviation of log-population from training median expressed in robust units, capturing extreme population areas
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized deviation score provides a smooth continuous feature aligned with linear SVM requirements

features.name: housing_turnover_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of housing turnover severity based on H40p4 level: low turnover areas score near 0, high turnover areas score near 1, reflecting market dynamism
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a calibrated continuous severity measure of housing market activity for linear SVM

features.name: demographic_concentration_index
features.description: Herfindahl-style concentration index approximation using squared proportions of P5p1 and P15p1 to measure demographic concentration
features.expected_model_benefit: Concentration index captures nonlinear demographic patterns in a single smooth feature for linear SVM
